annotations.title: Get Google Analytics daily performance summary

description: MisarSEO's own retained daily Google Analytics totals for the connected property: sessions, activeUsers, newUsers, engagementRate, bounceRate, conversions, screenPageViews. Read-only and FREE (no credits) — makes NO call to Google, reads only what the nightly sync (04:25 UTC) has archived. A property with no completed sync yet simply has no rows, not stale data.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_ga4_performance_summary
